plan.failureSummary: The cached page.ai instructions for selecting the 'Developers' navigation dropdown relied on a positional CSS selector (#nav > ... > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) that now targets the 'Solutions' menu instead. This caused the flow to navigate to a solutions use-case URL rather than '/docs/', failing the subsequent URL assertion.
observedIndicators: page.ai cache runSource targeted '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button' which matched the 'Solutions' dropdown button instead of 'Developers'
Recent tool calls show left click and hover actions on <button class=\"nav-item\" ...>Solutions</button> rather than Developers
Failure screenshot shows 'Product', 'Solutions', 'Developers', 'Resources' in the top navbar, confirming 'Developers' is present on the page

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and rerun flow autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the deterministic page.ai cache for checkly.test.ts so Donobu can re-resolve the Developers dropdown and Documentation navigation links autonomously.

plan.notes: The live page layout shows 'Developers' as the third navigation menu item (after 'Product' and 'Solutions'). Clearing the page.ai cache and allowing autonomous execution will correctly resolve the 'Developers' dropdown and its 'Documentation' item.
